intent: Adjusted geometry to improve stability and reduce line loss events.
rationale: The telemetry indicates that the robot experienced 5 line loss events, which suggests that the current geometry is not optimal for maintaining line following. To address this, I will adjust the geometry to improve stability and sensor effectiveness. I propose a body length of 0.2m, a body width of 0.15m, and a mass of 1.0kg. These changes aim to enhance the robot's ability to stay on track and reduce line loss events. I expect these adjustments will lead to improved performance in the next iteration.
